trust_decision.summary: A client-supplied username (e.g. HTTP Basic auth user on enroll) is formatted unescaped into the configured LDAP UserFilter in ldap.Client.GetUser, which decides which single directory entry becomes the identity; the fix escapes it with ldap.EscapeFilter.

landing_point.why: Advisory title names GetUser's filter; the only fmt.Sprintf(lc.UserFilter, ...) in the tree is here.

fix_sites.entry_point: every server route resolving an identity via the registry when LDAP is enabled, primarily POST /enroll basic auth (lib/serverrequestcontext.go:107)
fix_sites.module_kind: core LDAP registry client (the sink itself)

fix_sites.entry_point: none (AdminConn type changed to an interface for test mocking; not security relevant)
none (Dial -> DialURL API migration; not security relevant)
none (DialTLS -> DialURL API migration; not security relevant)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: No second filter builder: GroupFilter is configured (lib/server/ldap/client.go:112) but never formatted or searched anywhere in the non-vendor tree; NewSearchRequest occurs only at lib/server/ldap/client.go:172.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Nothing to dismiss: all registry callers (enroll, reenroll, register, revoke, identities, attribute lookups) funnel into the single GetUser sink, which the one-line fix covers.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Operators may supply a custom UserFilter with %s (lib/server/ldap/client.go:37, :111); an over-broad fix that escapes or validates the whole filter template, or rejects usernames with legitimate characters, would break custom filters / normal logins.

O6_input_shapes: plain string username containing filter metacharacters * ( ) \ (and NUL via EscapeFilter)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A group-membership search formatting GroupFilter with the user DN or affiliation name, unescaped.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: GroupFilter is already configured and documented as 'filter for a single affiliation group' but has no consumer; a maintainer adding group-based affiliation lookup would plausibly Sprintf it the same way.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Affiliation derived by naive strings.Split on ',' of the DN (escaped commas in RDN values mis-split) — a how-type identity-parsing differential if fed into a follow-up search.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Code already splits DNs naively; extending it to search OU entries would carry the value into a filter or DN without escaping.

O10_build.project_tests: lib/server/ldap/client_test.go (TestLDAP/TestLDAPTLS need a live LDAP server at localhost:10389; /ldap excluded in scripts/run_unit_tests:11). The fix adds a mock-connection test, which requires the AdminConn interface refactor (fix.diff:49-64).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap username with ldap.EscapeFilter before Sprintf into UserFilter — which is also the correct, complete fix.

out_of_scope_notes: GetAffiliationPath splits the DN on ',' without honouring escaped commas (lib/server/ldap/client.go:392); different mechanism, not pursued.
Hidden tests on GetUser need the Client.AdminConn field to accept a mock (fix.diff:63-64); our copy would have to ship that interface or test via a fake LDAP server.
